ops.text: c. TrueLink shall indemnify Client against any third-party claim that the Interface, the Hosting Services or the Support Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right, except to the extent the claim arises from modifications made by Client, combination of the foregoing by Client with items not supplied by TrueLink, or Client's specifications. If such a claim is made, TrueLink shall procure for Client the right to continue use of the affected item, modify it so that it is non-infringing, or replace it with a non-infringing equivalent, and if none of the foregoing is available, refund the fees paid for the affected item. TrueLink's total liability under this Section 12(c) shall not exceed 3x the annual fees paid by Client under this Agreement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity in 12(b) covers only its own breach, leaving us carrying third-party IP infringement claims on the Interface and Hosting and Support Services. We have added the fallback vendor IP indemnity with the usual Client modification, combination and specification exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual fees super-cap, leaving Client's clause 12(a) untouched as the smaller edit.
proposal.summary: Insert TrueLink IP infringement indemnity with standard exclusions, remedies and 3x annual fees super-cap
